headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 27, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 13.67% compared to SPY's 9.07%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 4.59%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has delivered a remarkable return of 45.37%, significantly contributing to the overall portfolio strength. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100,' has returned 7.23%, which is still above the benchmark but highlights the variance within the group. This performance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it suggests resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
